content:
Maria K: Quick request — can someone run a performance scan for calliope-9b-v2 on g5-smallpool? Need P95 tail latency and sustained throughput at concurrency 8 and 32 for PR #4822. Also include peak GPU mem, p50/p95 per-token latency, and a short note if KV-cache warmup changes numbers. Thanks!

Ezra: I can pick this up, unless Alex had already started.

Alex: Not started, go for it.

Ezra: Kicked off a quick smoke now. Will do full sweep and post artifacts.

perf-bot: Started job perf-scan/1987654321 on g5-smallpool (caller=Ezra).

Ezra: Command I'm running (so it's reproducible):
```
./tools/run_perf_scan \n  --model calliope-9b-v2 \n  --pool g5-smallpool \n  --concurrency 8,32 \n  --seq-len 512 \n  --warmup-requests 100 \n  --samples 200 \n  --kv-cache true \n  --use-quant int8 \n  --output /tmp/calliope_perf.json
```

Ezra: Note — using int8 quant path to match recommended serving config. If you want FP16 numbers, tell me and I'll rerun.

Devon: Quick FYI @eng-runtime — if tail lat looks noisy check kernel-selection logs and whether CUDA graph warmup fired. Seen variance when graph didn't compile.

Ezra: Smoke results (summary):
- concurrency=8: sustained throughput ~48 tok/s, p50 token latency 19ms, p95 token latency 45ms, peak GPU mem 18.9GiB
- concurrency=32: sustained throughput ~170 tok/s, p50 token latency 22ms, p95 token latency 78ms, peak GPU mem 20.6GiB
- KV-cache effect: cold -> p95 about +15% in first 20 requests, stabilizes after ~60 warmup requests

Ezra: Uploading full JSON + flamegraphs to S3: s3://redwood-perf/calliope-9b-v2/1987654321/ (will update when done)

perf-bot: Job perf-scan/1987654321 finished (status=success). Artifacts: /artifacts/1987654321/calliope_perf.json, /artifacts/1987654321/flame.html

Alex: Nice — numbers look sane. A couple quick asks: (1) can you capture per-layer KV cache miss profile? (2) include sequence length 1024 run for latency headroom.

Ezra: Yep can add. Requeueing a follow-up with --seq-len 1024 and a KV miss trace. ETA ~25m.

Maria K: Awesome — once you have the 1024 runs, please upload artifacts and drop links in PR #4822. Also add a 1-2 line recommendation: serve int8 or fp16 with these SLOs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Noted: link PR #4822 -> perf artifacts pending.

Ezra: Follow-up done. Key diffs for seq=1024:
- concurrency=8: p95 token latency 72ms (up from 45ms at 512), throughput ~26 tok/s
- concurrency=32: p95 token latency 210ms, throughput ~95 tok/s
- KV warmup effect larger at 1024 (~25% p95 bump first 100 requests)
Full artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/calliope-9b-v2/1987654321/seq1024/

Devon: Thanks — I'll glance at kernel logs later today. If anything looks off we can try forcing alternate kernel selection for the attention op.

Maria K: Perfect, this is exactly what I needed. Please add a 1-line README in the artifact folder summarizing the recommended serving config (int8, concurrency target, seq length caveat). Closing out unless anyone objects.

Alex: No objections. Good work.

Ezra: Done — added README + linked PR.

Maria K: Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
